decisions.reason: As a low-cost extension of the existing anamnesis app for larger practices, it remains a close-to-core niche option with little downside to keeping and no clear signal that its value will not materialize.

The materials management module fits the firm's integrated practice-software logic and broad installed base, so despite still-young demand uncertainty it is worth keeping open while market feedback accumulates.

Secure healthcare messaging is strategically aligned with regulation-driven digital workflows and the firm's health-IT direction, making it a sensible option to retain unless later evidence shows weak uptake or excessive support costs.
